Method of Attack: Allows maliciously crafted PDF documents to call home and send over the victim's NTLM hash to remote attackers in the form of an SMB request
In-memory micropatch fix for zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Reader preventing automatic loading of remote XML style sheet via SMB
Discoverer: Mitja Kolsek, CEO of ACROS Security
Impacted Systems: Adobe Acrobat Reader DC 19.010.20069 and likely all earlier versions up to this one
Attack Vector: Malicious PDF document with element triggering automatic loading of remote XML style sheet via SMB using UNC path
Indicators of Compromise: SMB request containing user's NTLM hash
Malicious PDF document exploiting zero-day vulnerability
